title: fix(plugin-auth, platform-objects): resending an expired invitation replaces it, leaving one pending invitation
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XC7EVd3zBgDP3FhGA6C2k7Q)_

Fixes #28540

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：管理员对一条已过期的邀请点「重新发送邀请」时，系统照旧发出一份新邀请，但现在会把同一个人在同一组织里已过期、仍显示「待处理」的旧邀请标为「已过期」，所以「待处理」列表里每人只剩一行。直接再次邀请同一邮箱也一样。确认文案改为在两种情况下都成立：「有效期重新计算；已过期的邀请会被一份新邀请取代」（中、日、西语同步）。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28540（来自 #28384 开发报告的实测发现）：better-auth 找待处理邀请时会跳过已过期的行，于是重发生成了新邀请，旧行一直挂在「待处理」，原文案「其有效期重新开始」也不对。
- **风险与回滚**：只在 invite-member 成功之后动作；被拒的请求什么都不改。未过期的邀请重发照旧续期（同一个 id）。别人的邀请、其他组织的邀请不受影响。改状态失败只记 warn，不影响新邀请。复制链接的门禁（#28529）未改动。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-expired-supersede.ts`（新的退役步骤）；`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-after-hook.ts`（接入点）；`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-resend-expired.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/invitation-resend-expired.test.ts` → 15/15 通过（其中 5 条是本卡的）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The retire step** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-expired-supersede.ts`, new). better-auth 1.7.12's `invite-member` looks up the person's pending invitation with `findPendingInvitation`, which drops every row whose `expiresAt` has passed (`organization/adapter.mjs`). So a resend (`resend: true`, the `resend_invitation` row action) on an invitation that has already expired finds nothing to renew and issues a new invitation, and the expired row kept reading `pending` forever. `retireExpiredInvitationsOnReissue(ctx)` runs in the global `after` hook, right after the delivery-outcome stamp, and only on a successful invite-member answer. It reads the answered person's pending rows in that organization through the vendor's own adapter (`ctx.context.adapter.findMany` on model `invitation`), skips the answered row by id and every row still before its expiry, and moves the rest to `expired` with a write that names `status: 'pending'` beside the id (a row that was accepted, declined or canceled meanwhile is not touched).

- **Status `expired`**, not `canceled`: the row did expire, `expired` is the ObjectStack half of `InvitationStatus` (better-auth has no such value), and the row now shows in the Expired / Canceled list.
- **Expiry predicate** is the copy-link gate's own `isBeforeExpiry` (`invitation-link-action.ts`), now exported for reuse; the gate itself is unchanged. An expiry that does not read as a date counts as expired, as the vendor and the gate read it.
- **Failure-isolated.** The new invitation is already written and its mail handed off when this runs, so a read or write that fails leaves the old row as it was, says so once at `warn`, and never turns the issued invitation into an error.
- **The adapter is typed** with a two-method local interface (`findMany` / `update` with keyword objects), so `check:tenant-audit-census` reads the receiver as the better-auth adapter rather than an unplaced engine write; no ledger row is added.

**The confirmation** (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-invitation.object.ts`). `resend_invitation`'s `description` now reads "Resend the invitation to (the record.email hole)? The expiry date starts over, and an invitation that has already expired is replaced by a new one." It is true on both rows Resend is offered on. Its `ai.description` says the same. The `en` bundle is regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`; the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES leaves are re-translated by hand (a stale translation is not a gap, so the merge keeps it otherwise).

**Not changed:** the copy-link gate from #28529 (its `visible` and handler), Resend's `visible` (still offered on an expired row: resend is the remedy), the invite-member answer's shape, and the vendor's renewal of an unexpired row.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-resend-expired.test.ts` (new): a real `AuthManager` over the installed better-auth and the memory engine, every invitation issued and resent through the vendor's own route (the harness of `invitation-delivery-outcome.test.ts`, cut to two people).

- A resend on an expired pending row: 200, a new id, exactly one pending row for the person (the new one), the old row reads `expired`.
- A plain invite after the earlier invitation expired: the same.
- Control: a resend on an unexpired pending row keeps one row, the same id, and a later expiry.
- Control: an invite for a new address leaves another person's expired pending row and the same person's expired row in another organization reading `pending`.
- Control: a refused resend (a plain member, 403) retires nothing.

Readings:

- **Red first** (prod sources at `origin/main` a52191f6, test at head): 2 failed / 13 passed, the two expired cases; every control green on base.
- **Ablation** via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, retire step only (anchor `if (!row || row.id === answeredId || isBeforeExpiry(row.expiresAt)) continue;` prefixed with an always-true `["ABL28540"].length > 0 ||`): anchor 1 → 0, blob `25bc42e6c78c` → `78d9bfb5c76e`; 2 failed / 13 passed, the two expired cases only; restore blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The suite imports `src/` directly, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
- **Green** on head 1a454b7a: the new file and `invitation-delivery-outcome.test.ts` 47/47.
- Package suites on df411420 (after the merge and a rebuild): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` Test Files 208 passed (208), Tests 3958 passed, 10 skipped; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` Test Files 106 passed (106), Tests 1488 passed; both `typecheck` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Seam.** The claim pointed at the before hook. The retire step sits in the after hook instead: before the vendor runs, the caller is not yet admitted, and a status write there would happen for refused and unauthenticated calls too. The claim's file surface did not list `auth-manager-after-hook.ts`, `invitation-link-action.ts` (one `export` keyword) or the new module; the seat may amend it.
- **Plain invite included.** A plain invite to an address whose invitation expired had the same two-row defect through the same vendor lookup; the one seam covers both, and it is pinned.
- **Test placement.** The cases live in a new file rather than in `invitation-delivery-outcome.test.ts`, whose tests already take about 10 s of wall. Like 33 other plugin-auth test files, the new file imports `createMemoryEngine` from `impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts`, which also runs that file's 10 cases inside it (observed, not filed).
- **Overlap.** Open PRs re-read before `pr_create`: none touches `auth-manager-before-hook.ts`, `auth-manager-after-hook.ts`, `invitation-link-action.ts` or `sys-invitation.object.ts`. PR #28543 edits the same four `*.objects.generated.ts` bundles at line 108 (`env_native`), this PR at line 851: separate hunks.
- **Security.** The old invitation's link stays dead (it was already refused once past its expiry); nothing revives an expired invitation.

## Verification

All readings on head df411420 (1a454b7a merged with `origin/main` cd065d36, which brought in PR #28543's edits to the same bundles; the merge was clean). Nothing landed on this branch after these runs.

- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 63 families, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0 on df411420. `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 63 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).` First-run reds on an earlier head and their fixes: `check-tenant-audit-census` exit 1 (an untyped `adapter.update()` receiver) → the adapter typed, exit 0; `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 on the shallow clone → `git fetch --depth=1` of its control commit, exit 0; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (no `dist/` yet) → exit 0 after the i18n gate's build closure (115 entry points across 70 packages load).
- **Hand gates**, each exit 0 on df411420: `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`, `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`, `node scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs`, and `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the five touched source files (neither package has a `lint` script; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- **Dogfood:** not owed (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).
- **CI** families are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
